title: Run final build typecheck lint and test suite
description: Run the complete local release gate on the final worktree, including version, lint, typecheck, custom optimization tests, build, artifact checks, and focused tests.
acceptanceCriteria: `npm run version:check`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `TURBO_DISABLE=true npx tsx scripts/test-optimizations.ts`, and `TURBO_DISABLE=true npm run build` all exit 0
Focused new tests and security/docs/artifact checks all exit 0
Build is performed from the nested app root with the required standalone configuration
Any warning is recorded and assessed; a warning is not silently treated as a pass

steps.details: Record git status/diff and ensure only task-owned files changed; do not reset or overwrite unrelated user changes.
Run version check, lint, and typecheck in the documented order; capture exit codes and concise logs.
Run custom/focused tests and standalone build with `TURBO_DISABLE=true`; capture artifact/asset validation.
Write `.agent/evidence/task-70-final-local-gate.md` with commands, exit codes, warning dispositions, and artifact path/digest.

technicalNotes: Do not run the build from the wrapper root; all npm commands run from `xistance-panel/`. Keep secrets out of environment dumps and evidence.
